EducationDelivery_course_location_mode_u.name: EducationDelivery_course_location_mode_unique
EducationDelivery_course_location_mode_u.where: coalesce("EducationDelivery"."siteId", "EducationDelivery"."campusId") is not null and "EducationDelivery"."mode" is not null and length(trim("EducationDelivery"."mode")) > 0

EducationIntake_delivery_code_period_uni.name: EducationIntake_delivery_code_period_unique
EducationIntake_delivery_code_period_uni.where: "EducationIntake"."intakeCode" is not null and ("EducationIntake"."year" is not null or "EducationIntake"."startDate" is not null)

EducationIntake_delivery_date_period_uni.name: EducationIntake_delivery_date_period_unique
EducationIntake_delivery_date_period_uni.where: "EducationIntake"."intakeCode" is null and "EducationIntake"."startDate" is not null
